description: This file contains a Python class 'Git' that provides methods for interacting with a Git repository, including operations like checkout, commit, branch management, and diff analysis. It is part of a larger codebase related to webkitpy and version control automation.

classes.name: Git
classes.description: A class providing an interface to perform various Git operations such as checkout, commit, branch management, diff analysis, and configuration queries within a repository context.

methods.name: _init_executable_name
methods.description: Initializes the executable name for Git, with a workaround for Windows batch scripts.

methods.name: _run_git
methods.description: Executes a Git command with specified arguments and options, returning the output or exit code.

methods.name: absolute_path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path for a repository-relative path.

methods.name: in_working_directory
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a Git working directory.

methods.name: find_checkout_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the Git checkout for a given path.

methods.name: read_git_config
methods.description: Reads a Git configuration value for a given key.

methods.name: _discard_local_commits
methods.description: Resets local commits to match the remote branch.

methods.name: _local_commits
methods.description: Returns a list of local commits since a specified reference.

methods.name: _rebase_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if a rebase is currently in progress.

methods.name: has_working_directory_changes
methods.description: Checks for uncommitted changes in the working directory.

methods.name: _discard_working_directory_changes
methods.description: Resets working directory changes and aborts rebase if in progress.

methods.name: unstaged_changes
methods.description: Lists files with unstaged or untracked changes.

methods.name: add_list
methods.description: Adds files to the staging area.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes files from the repository.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves or renames a file.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the latest commit.

methods.name: current_branch
methods.description: Returns the current branch name or empty if HEAD is detached.

methods.name: current_branch_or_ref
methods.description: Returns the current branch name or commit hash if detached.

methods.name: _upstream_branch
methods.description: Gets the upstream branch for the current branch.

methods.name: _merge_base
methods.description: Calculates the merge base for a given commit or the remote branch.

methods.name: changed_files
methods.description: Returns a list of files changed since a specific commit.

methods.name: added_files
methods.description: Returns a list of added files.

methods.name: status_command
methods.description: Returns the Git command to check status.

methods.name: _status_regexp
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to parse status output.

methods.name: supports_local_commits
methods.description: Indicates support for local commits.

methods.name: display_name
methods.description: Returns the display name for the version control system.

methods.name: most_recent_log_matching
methods.description: Finds the most recent commit matching a grep string.

methods.name: _commit_position_from_git_log
methods.description: Extracts the commit position from a git log string.

methods.name: commit_position
methods.description: Returns the latest Chromium commit position in the checkout.

methods.name: _commit_position_regex_for_timestamp
methods.description: Returns regex pattern for commit timestamp.

methods.name: timestamp_of_revision
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of a specific revision.

methods.name: create_patch
methods.description: Creates a patch file for a commit or set of files.

methods.name: _patch_order
methods.description: Determines the order of patch application based on configuration.

methods.name: commit_position_from_git_commit
methods.description: Gets the commit position from a specific git commit.

methods.name: checkout_branch
methods.description: Checks out a branch.

methods.name: create_clean_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch from the current state.

methods.name: blame
methods.description: Runs git blame on a file.

methods.name: _branch_ref_exists
methods.description: Checks if a branch reference exists.

methods.name: delete_branch
methods.description: Deletes a branch.

methods.name: _remote_merge_base
methods.description: Calculates the merge base with remote origin/master.

methods.name: _remote_branch_ref
methods.description: Returns the remote branch reference.

methods.name: commit_locally_with_message
methods.description: Commits all changes with a message.

methods.name: pull
methods.description: Performs a git pull.

methods.name: latest_git_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest commit hash.

methods.name: git_commits_since
methods.description: Returns commits since a specific commit.

methods.name: git_commit_detail
methods.description: Returns details of a specific commit.

methods.name: affected_files
methods.description: Lists files affected by a commit.

methods.name: _branch_tracking_remote_master
methods.description: Finds the local branch tracking origin/master.

methods.name: is_cleanly_tracking_remote_master
methods.description: Checks if the local branch is cleanly tracking remote master.

methods.name: ensure_cleanly_tracking_remote_master
methods.description: Ensures the local branch is cleanly tracking remote master.
